content: Suru wɔkurɑ yirusen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ itɑse ye, yɑ turɑ. Tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔrɑ sinɑ bokon woodɑ ye u rɑɑ yi Yuubɑn sɔ̃ yɑ koo sɔmburu tore. Tɔ̃ɔ terɑ Yuubɑn yibɛrɛbɑ bɑ yĩiyɔ bu Yuubɑ kɑmiɑ. Adɑmɑ n ǹ koore. Yuubɑrɑ bɑ nɑsɑrɑ suɑ.
Asuresin tem kpuro sɔɔ, Yuubɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ wuu mi bɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpuro. Mɑ bɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ wɔri be bɑ rɑɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bu kɑ bu ɡo mi. Goo sɑri wi u kɑ tii yinɑ. Domi bɑ ben bɛrum mɔwɑ.
Sinɑ bokon tem beri berikɑn wiruɡibu kɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu kɑ win tem wiruɡibu kɑ win tiin sɔm kowobu bɑ kɑ Yuubɑ yɔ̃rɑ domi bɑ Mɑɑdosen bɛrum mɔ.
Mɑɑdose wi, u ɑye bɛɛrɛɡiru mɔ sinɑ kpɑɑru mi. Mɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ. Mɑ win dɑm mu sosimɔ mu dɔɔ.
Yuubɑ bɑ ben yibɛrɛ be kuɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ kĩ. Bɑ bu ɡowɑ ɡem ɡem.
Susi mɑro sɔɔ, tɔmbu nɛɛrɑ wunɔbuwɑ (500) bɑ ɡo.
Mɑ bɑ Pɑɑsɑndɑtɑ kɑ Dɑlifoni kɑ Asipɑtɑ sɑkirɑ,
kɑ Porɑtɑ kɑ Adɑliɑ kɑ Aridɑtɑ
kɑ Pɑɑmɑsitɑ kɑ Aridɑi kɑ Fɑyesɑtɑ
kɑ sere mɑɑ Hɑmɑni Yuubɑn yibɛrɛn bibu wɔkuru. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ ben dukiɑ ɡure.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bɑ sinɑ boko tɔn ben ɡeeru sɔ̃ɔwɑ be bɑ ɡo Susi mɑro mi.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Ɛsitɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee Yuubɑ bɑ tɔmbu nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu (500) ɡo mini kɑ Hɑmɑnin bibu wɔkuru. Amɔnɑ n ko n sɑ̃ɑ wuu si su tie sɔɔ. Tɛ̃, ɑ̀ n mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kĩ ɑ mɑn bikio, kon nun ye kuɑ.
Mɑ Ɛsitɛɛ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ̀ n wurɑn nɑ, ɑ de siɑ Yuubɑ bu mɑɑ ko Susi mini nɡe mɛ woodɑ ye, yɑ ɡeruɑ. Kpɑ bu Hɑmɑnin bibu wɔku ten ɡonu bwɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑɔ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ wɛ̃ bu mɑɑ ko nɡe mɛ. Mɑ bɑ ye kpɑrɑ Susiɔ. Mɑ bɑ Hɑmɑnin bibu wɔku ten ɡonu bwɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑɔ.
Yuu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Susi mɑroɔ, bɑ Adɑrin sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛ ye sɔɔ mɛnnɑ. Mɑ bɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu (300) ɡo. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ ben dukiɑ ɡure.

Yuu be bɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛn beri berikɑɔ bɑ mɑɑ mɛnnɑ bu kɑ ben wɑ̃ɑru wɔrɑ. Mɑ bɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ mwɛɛrɑ bɑ ɡo. Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ ben dukiɑ ɡure. Tɔn be bɑ ɡo mi, ben ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu (75.000).
Yeni yɑ koorɑwɑ suru wi bɑ mɔ̀ Adɑrin sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ itɑse sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛse sɔɔrɑ bɑ tɔn ɡoberu deri. Mɑ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di kɑ nuku dobu.
Adɑmɑ Yuu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Susi mɑroɔ, bɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ ɡowɑ sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ itɑse kɑ sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛse sɔɔ. Sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔrɑ bɑ wɛ̃rɑ. Mɑ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di kɑ nuku dobu.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ Yuu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ bɑru kpɑɑnɔ bɑ rɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru di kɑ nuku dobu Adɑrin sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛse te sɔɔ. Kpɑ bu kɛ̃nu mɔrisiɑnɑ.
Mɑɑdose
u tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrun tɔ̃ru yi
Yenibɑn biru, Mɑɑdose u ɡɑri yi yoruɑ tirenu sɔɔ. Mɑ u Yuu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ turuku kɑ tontondeɔ tire ni mɔrisiɑ Asuresin tem mɛ kpuro sɔɔ.
U ben bɑɑwure kɑnɑ bɑ n dɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te di wɔ̃ɔ bɑɑɡere suru wi bɑ mɔ̀ Adɑrin sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ nnɛse kɑ nɔɔbuse sɔɔ.
Kpɑ bu kɛ̃nu mɔrisiɑnɑ. Kpɑ bu sɑ̃ɑrobu kɛ̃nu kɛ̃. Domi tɔ̃ɔ te sɔɔrɑ Yuubɑ bɑ ben yibɛrɛbɑ kɑmiɑ bɑ dɛrɑ. Suru wi sɔɔrɑ ben nuku sɑnkirɑnu nu ɡɔsiɑ nuku dobu. Mɑ ben nɔni swɑ̃ɑru tɑ kuɑ bɔri yɛndu.
Mɑ Yuubɑ bɑ Mɑɑdosen ɡere ye mɛm nɔɔwɑ, bɑ wurɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te, tu ko wororu.
Domi Hɑmɑni, Hɑmɛdɑtɑn bii, Aɡɑɡiɡii wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Yuubɑn yibɛrɛ u rɑɑ himbɑ kuɑ u Yuubɑ kpuro ɡo. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u ɡubɑ kɔ̃ u kɑ wɑ tɔ̃ɔ te u koo Yuubɑ nɔni sɔ̃ kpɑ u bu ɡo.
Adɑmɑ Ɛsitɛɛ u dɑ sinɑ bokon mi. Mɑ sinɑ boko u woodɑ yɑrɑ u nɛɛ, ye Hɑmɑni u rɑɑ himbɑ kuɑ mi, yu wɔri win wiru wɔllɔ kpɑ bu wi kɑ win bibu bwɛ̃ dɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ ni sokɑ Purimu ben tɛtɛ dumin sɔ̃. Yuubɑ bɑ Mɑɑdosen tire ten ɡɑri mɛm nɔɔwɑ ye bɑ bu kuɑ kɑ ye bɑ wɑn sɔ̃.
Mɑ Yuubɑ bɑ tɔ̃ɔ ni kuɑ wororu te bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu kɔsi ben bibun bweseru kɑ be bɑ koo rɑ tii koo Yuun sɔ̃. Wɔ̃ɔ bɑɑɡere, sɔ̃ɔ yiru ye sɔɔ, bɑ ko n dɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru diwɑ nɡe mɛ Mɑɑdose u yen woodɑ yi.
Bɑ ko n dɑ tɔ̃ɔ ni yɑɑyewɑ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ Isirelibɑn yɛnu bɑɑɡere sɔɔ. Mi Yuubɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡesi, bɑ ko n dɑ Purimun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te diwɑ sere kɑ ben bibun bweserɔ.
Ɛsitɛɛ, Abisɑilin bii, kɑ Mɑɑdose bɑ mɑɑ tirenu ɡɑnu yoruɑ fuuku bu kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ten ɡɑri dɑm sire.
Yuubɑ kpurowɑ bɑ tire ni mɔrisiɑ mi bɑ yɑrinɛ Asuresin tem beri wunɑɑ teeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru ye sɔɔ. Alɑfiɑ kɑ bɔri yɛndun ɡɑriyɑ yi wɑ̃ɑ tire ni sɔɔ.
Nu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ n dɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ te di ten sɑɑ sɔɔ nɡe mɛ Ɛsitɛɛ kɑ Mɑɑdose bɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Bɑ n dɑ ko mɛ, sere kɑ ben bibun bweserɔ nɡe mɛ bɑ kuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ weeweenu kuɑ bɑ nɔɔ bɔkuɑ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Ɛsitɛɛn woodɑ ye, yɑ kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ ten dɑm sire. Mɑ bɑ ye yoruɑ tireru sɔɔ.
